result.brief: 提出无标签自监督框架 iSEE，通过物体证据建模、外观-位置分离与重现线索实现遮挡下的物体恒存，并将位置流作为世界模型的动作用于下游规划。
result.reason: Self-supervised object permanence in video slots, with position stream used as action for a world model and downstream planning—directly supports video world models and object-centric video representation.
